release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.3 strengthens local postflop CPU play. It builds sequential Bayesian opponent ranges from the immutable 174-scenario preflop charts and observed raise sizes, feeds those ranges plus persistent opponent behavior into postflop equity and response modeling, corrects equity realization for all-in calls, and adds SPR/street-aware geometric bet sizing. Existing 174 preflop CPU actions and postflop action controls are retained.
